Dear Ms. Aris,

I am writing because North Star Insurance rejected my claim for the procedure I had on January 14th. I was very surprised to receive a denial letter yesterday saying that the $1,850 charge was not covered because of a mistake in the billing code.

The insurance company told me that my paperwork was marked as a "Routine Screening," but I actually had a "Contrast-Enhanced MRI." Because these are different procedures, the insurance company denied the whole claim. I checked my receipt from the Evergreen Clinic, and it correctly lists the MRI. This seems to be a simple error, but it is causing me a lot of stress.

I already called your billing coordinator, Sarah, last week to check on this. She told me the paperwork was likely fine and asked me to wait. I am disappointed that my concerns were dismissed, as this is a large bill. I have always paid my co-pays on time, and I expect the same level of care from your office when handling my billing.

This is urgent because I only have ten business days to appeal the decision with my insurance company. If the code is not corrected and resubmitted quickly, I will be stuck paying the full amount for a mistake that was not my fault. I have attached the denial letter and the doctor’s original referral for your records.

Could you please send the corrected form to North Star Insurance by the end of this week? Please send me a quick email or a tracking number to confirm it has been sent so I can update my insurance provider. I would really like to get this fixed as soon as possible.

Thank you for your help in resolving this.

Sincerely,
Jonathan Miller
